## v42.0.0 Release Notes

This release adds support for Pexip Infinity v42 and renames the provider's resources, data sources and actions to follow the standard Terraform naming convention.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains breaking changes. Read the [v42 upgrade guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/pexip/infinity/latest/docs/guides/v42_upgrade) before upgrading. Existing state must be migrated, or Terraform will plan to destroy and recreate your resources.

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

### Resources, data sources and actions renamed (#78)

The redundant `pexip_` prefix has been removed so that type names match the provider name:

| Before v42 | v42 and later |
|---|---|
| `pexip_infinity_conference` | `infinity_conference` |
| `data.pexip_infinity_manager_config` | `data.infinity_manager_config` |
| `action.pexip_delete_default_mgr_tls_certificate` | `action.infinity_delete_default_mgr_tls_certificate` |

The provider source address (`pexip/infinity`) is unchanged.

**Action required:**
1. Rename the provider local name to `infinity` in `required_providers` in **every** module, and rename the `provider "pexip"` block to `provider "infinity"`.
2. Rename resource, data source and action types in your configuration.
3. Migrate existing state, either with `moved` blocks (Terraform 1.8 or later) or by editing the state file.

The [upgrade guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/pexip/infinity/latest/docs/guides/v42_upgrade) includes commands that automate each step.

### Provider environment variables renamed (#78)

| Before v42 | v42 and later |
|---|---|
| `PEXIP_ADDRESS` | `INFINITY_ADDRESS` |
| `PEXIP_USERNAME` | `INFINITY_USERNAME` |
| `PEXIP_PASSWORD` | `INFINITY_PASSWORD` |
| `PEXIP_INSECURE` | `INFINITY_INSECURE` |

The old names are no longer read. **Action required:** update any CI pipelines or shell profiles that set them.

### Attributes that can no longer be set

The following attributes are now computed-only. **Action required:** remove them from your configuration.

| Resource | Attributes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `infinity_global_configuration` | `default_webapp_alias` | Set `is_default = true` on an `infinity_webapp_alias` resource instead (#60) |
| `infinity_global_configuration` | `enable_clock` | Deprecated in Infinity and ignored (#70) |
| `infinity_ms_exchange_connector` | `oauth_auth_endpoint`, `oauth_redirect_uri`, `oauth_refresh_token`, `oauth_state` | Deprecated in Infinity and ignored (#76) |
| `infinity_mjx_exchange_deployment` | `oauth_client_id`, `oauth_auth_endpoint`, `oauth_token_endpoint`, `oauth_redirect_uri`, `oauth_refresh_token`, `oauth_state` | Deprecated in Infinity and ignored (#79) |

### Attributes now marked sensitive (#69)

These attributes are now marked `sensitive`, so Terraform hides their values in plan output:

- `infinity_global_configuration`: `gcp_private_key`, `legacy_api_password`
- `infinity_ssh_password_hash`: `password`, `hash`
- `infinity_web_password_hash`: `password`, `hash`

**Action required:** any `output` that references one of these attributes must now set `sensitive = true`, or `terraform plan` fails.

## Behaviour Changes

- **`infinity_global_configuration`:** the default `content_security_policy_header` is now more restrictive. The `telemetryservice.firstpartyapps.oaspapps.com` and `*.office.com` sources have been removed from `frame-src`. If you don't set this attribute, the next apply updates it to the new default (#70).
- **`infinity_global_configuration`:** `terraform plan` now shows a warning when enabling or disabling `enable_sip`, `enable_h323`, `enable_sip_tcp`, `enable_sip_udp` or `enable_rtmp`, because these changes trigger a restart of all conferencing nodes (#80).

## New Features

### `infinity_global_configuration` (#70)

New attributes:
- `enable_mssip`: enable Skype for Business support within the SIP protocol (default `false`)
- `enable_sip_tcp`: enable SIP over TCP (default `false`)
- `restrict_cors_origins`: only set `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` for recognised origins (default `true`)
- `transcript_mode_vmr_default`: default transcript mode for VMRs (default `ondemand`)

### `infinity_conference`: `transcript_mode` (#71)

Controls transcript requirements for a conference. Accepted values are `default`, `besteffort`, `ondemand` and `disallowed`.

### `infinity_event_sink`: `events` (#72)

Specifies the set of events sent to the event sink.

### `infinity_identity_provider` (#74)

- New `email_attribute_name` (SAML) and `oidc_email_claim_name` (OIDC) attributes
- `oidc_token_signature_scheme` now accepts `rs512`

### `infinity_media_processing_server`: `registration_private_key` (#75)

Exposes the JWT private key used for registration to the media processing server, as a computed, sensitive attribute.

### `infinity_ms_exchange_connector`: Microsoft Graph API support (#76)

- `exchange_api_type` (default `EWS`), `graph_api_domain` (default `graph.microsoft.com`) and `graph_authentication_method` (default `APP_PERM`)
- `oauth_certificate` and `oauth_private_key` for certificate-based authentication with Microsoft Entra
- `personal_vmr_idp` for the Identity Provider used to sign users in to the Outlook add-in

### `infinity_policy_server`: `allow_http` (#77)

Allows HTTP (insecure) URLs for the external policy server. Default `false`; intended for testing only.

### `infinity_webapp_alias`: `is_default` is now configurable (#60)

Set `is_default = true` to make a web app alias the default for `/webapp`. Previously this attribute was computed-only.

## Dependency Updates

- Pexip Infinity SDK: v41 → v42 (#81)
- `google.golang.org/grpc`: 1.82.1 → 1.83.2 (#63, #68)
- `golang.org/x/crypto`: 0.52.0 → 0.55.0
- `golang.org/x/net`: 0.55.0 → 0.58.0

## CI/CD Improvements

- Integration tests and the deploy/destroy jobs now use the provider built from the branch instead of the latest registry release (#78)
- Integration tests now target Pexip Infinity v42 GA images
- `softprops/action-gh-release` bumped to v3.0.3 (#67)
